title: Add default manufacturing version number series
summary: Manufacturing Setup now supports optional default number series for production BOM and routing versions, with new headers inheriting these defaults when their own series is blank.
key_points: Optional default number series fields added to Manufacturing Setup for production BOM versions and routing versions
New headers inherit setup defaults only when their Version Nos. field is blank
Existing headers and explicit values remain unchanged; blank setup preserves prior behavior
Contoso dataset creates PRODBOM-V and ROUTING-V series and assigns them only when setup is blank
Schema change mirrored in Italian localization layer with focused test coverage
quote: Adds optional default number series for production BOM versions and routing versions to Manufacturing Setup.
